name: Unique Selling Propositions Top Banner
author: Ioanna Mitroulaki

sections.description:
Unique Selling Propositions Top Banner is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that lets WordPress admins showcase up to three key selling propositions at the very top of their website. Perfect for quickly communicating benefits like free shipping, secure checkout, or fast delivery.

Features

  • Add and edit three unique selling propositions directly from the WordPress admin panel.
  • Banners are displayed prominently at the top of the site for maximum visibility.
  • Fully responsive design — displays in a carousel on mobile devices for better user experience.
  • Customize the look: set your own text color and background color to match your brand
  • Lightweight and easy to use — no coding required.
  • Ideal for eCommerce sites, service providers, and any business that wants to boost user trust and engagement.

No coding skills needed — just install, configure, and start converting!

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater
  • PHP version 8.0 or greater

Installation Instructions

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Upload and Extract the zip file in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Unique Selling Propositions > USPs
  4. Add the Unique Selling Propositions and select icons for them
  5. Go to Unique Selling Propositions > Style
  6. Choose the text and the background color for the top banner
  7. The top banner with Unique Selling Propositions will be displayed on the top of every page
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin displays a customizable top banner across your entire website to showcase three Unique Selling Propositions (USPs). You can define the USP texts, select icons and customize the banner’s text and background colors from the admin settings.

How many USPs can I add?

You can add three USPs in the plugin’s settings panel.

Can I change the colors of the banner?

Yes! The plugin allows you to customize both the text color and the background color of the top banner to match your site’s branding.

Where will the top banner appear on my site?

The banner will appear at the very top of every page, above your site’s header.

Can I disable the top banner on specific pages?

Currently, the plugin displays the banner site-wide. Selective disabling is not supported yet.
